next.reason: 1985: "PROGRAM-ID. program-name [ IS { |COMMON| |INITIAL| } PROGRAM ] ."; 2023: "PROGRAM-ID. program-name-1 [ AS literal-1 ] [ IS { |COMMON| |{INITIAL|RECURSIVE}| } PROGRAM ] .". Same paragraph, and COMMON/INITIAL in any order stay legal. 2023 adds an AS literal-1 phrase and a RECURSIVE alternative, so it accepts programs the 1985 format refuses.
